title: The Sleepy Bear
description: A bear who can't find the perfect spot to hibernate.

pages.text: Once upon a time, deep in a cozy forest, there lived a big brown bear named Bruno. Every autumn, when the leaves turned gold and red, Bruno would begin his search for the perfect sleeping spot.
Bruno wandered through the tall pine trees, his paws crunching softly on the fallen leaves. "I need somewhere warm and snug," he said, sniffing the cool autumn air.
First, Bruno tried a hollow log near the river. He squeezed himself inside, but it was far too small! His big fluffy bottom stuck right out the end.
Next, he found a cozy cave at the foot of a mossy hill. But when he peeked inside, three squirrels had already made it their home, and they were NOT happy to see him.
Bruno tried sleeping under a big oak tree. The roots curved up like a cradle around him. But the wind was too chilly, and the rain started to drip right on his nose.
He climbed a gentle hill and found a pile of soft golden leaves. Bruno curled into a ball and sighed happily. But before he could drift off, a family of rabbits hopped right on top of him!
By now the sky was turning pink and purple. Bruno sat down by a frozen pond and thought hard. His tummy was full of berries and honey. All he needed was the right spot.
Then Bruno noticed something he had walked right past all along — a wide, warm burrow tucked behind a waterfall of ivy. It smelled of pine needles and dry earth. Perfect.
Bruno padded inside and found a bed of soft moss and dried grass. He turned around three times, just as bears do, and curled up into the most comfortable ball.
Outside, the first snowflakes began to fall, dusting the forest in white. Inside his cozy burrow, Bruno smiled a sleepy smile and closed his eyes. He wouldn't wake up until spring. Goodnight, Bruno.
